text:
People are asking me how we are using Grok Bot at Hechura. So, in case you are wondering:

Grok Bot is running my daily GTM motion through collaboration of my Head of Sales and Head of Product Marketing agents.

Grok Bot is running my daily development work through collaboration of my Head of Engineering and QA agents, interacting with first class instances of the Cursor CLI to get the work done.

Grok Bot is running my Product requirements and customer discovery flows through collaboration of my PM and Document QA agents.

Grok Bot is running IT and Security tasks through collaboration of my IT and Security agents, securing environments, handling deployments, and reviewing code.

Like I've been saying: Grok Bot is like no other AI agent platform before it, in that it JUST WORKS!

Can't wait to see where the @cursor_ai and @SpaceXAI team takes things! I am here for it!
